import pandas as pd
from datetime import timedelta

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    target_snapshot = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc_events = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()
    watermark_df = inputs["watermark"]
    
    # Extract the high_ts watermark
    high_ts = watermark_df["high_ts"].iloc[0]
    
    # Filter events after watermark
    new_events = cdc_events[cdc_events["event_ts"] > high_ts].copy()
    
    # Sort events by user_id, then by event_ts, then by event_seq for deterministic ordering
    new_events = new_events.sort_values(by=["user_id", "event_ts", "event_seq"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Initialize result with target snapshot
    result = target_snapshot.copy()
    result = result.set_index("user_id")
    
    # Process each event sequentially per user
    for _, event in new_events.iterrows():
        user_id = event["user_id"]
        event_ts = event["event_ts"]
        op = event["op"]
        event_email = event["email"]
        
        if user_id not in result.index:
            # New user
            if op == "U":
                result.loc[user_id] = {
                    "email": event_email,
                    "status": "ACTIVE",
                    "status_ts": event_ts
                }
            elif op == "D":
                result.loc[user_id] = {
                    "email": event_email,
                    "status": "DELETED",
                    "status_ts": event_ts
                }
        else:
            current_row = result.loc[user_id]
            current_status = current_row["status"]
            current_email = current_row["email"]
            current_status_ts = current_row["status_ts"]
            
            if op == "D":
                # Soft delete: preserve current email, mark as DELETED
                result.loc[user_id, "status"] = "DELETED"
                result.loc[user_id, "status_ts"] = event_ts
                # Email stays as is (not set to event_email which may be null)
            
            elif op == "U":
                if current_status == "ACTIVE":
                    # Normal update
                    result.loc[user_id, "email"] = event_email
                    result.loc[user_id, "status"] = "ACTIVE"
                    result.loc[user_id, "status_ts"] = event_ts
                elif current_status == "DELETED":
                    # Check resurrection window: strictly more than 7 days
                    days_since_delete = (event_ts - current_status_ts).total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
                    if days_since_delete > 7:
                        # Resurrection: allow update
                        result.loc[user_id, "email"] = event_email
                        result.loc[user_id, "status"] = "ACTIVE"
                        result.loc[user_id, "status_ts"] = event_ts
                    else:
                        # Sticky deletion: reject update, preserve email
                        # Email stays as current_email (not changed)
                        pass
    
    # Reset index to convert back to column
    result = result.reset_index()
    result.columns.name = None
    
    return {"new_snapshot": result}
